.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r2/task/environment/instructions/overview.md:1-5 and grep of behaviour.md, integration.md, policy.md, security.md, ui.md for the identity axes
evidence: Static identity check; no runtime evidence is required for this row. (1) Name vs slug: task.toml:5 `name = "turing/colderwater-playground-devtools"` equals turing/<dirname> for the logical task directory recorded in manifest.json (`"task": "projects/colderwater-playground-devtools"`); the snapshot folder named `task` is excluded by the assignment. The slug has 3 hyphen-separated tokens. Org is `turing` as the skill delivery profile requires. (2) Description, task.toml:6 `A browser code playground with a custom editor, formatting, multiple carets, isolated preview and saved revisions.` Each axis is a real public requirement: custom editor (ui.md:3 `Build the code editing surface with your own DOM, canvas or SVG text model`), formatting (ui.md:15 `Provide Format document`), multiple carets (ui.md:9 `Alt+Click or Ctrl/Cmd+Click to add carets`), isolated preview (security.md:3 `runs in an isolated browser preview`; behaviour.md:3), saved revisions (behaviour.md:9,13; overview.md:3 `a revision history`). (3) Keywords, task.toml:7: retains template `webdev`, `turing`, `full-stack` (template task.toml:7) and replaces CHANGE_ME with `custom-editor`, `javascript`, `html`, `formatting`, `code-playground`, `devtools`; all match instruction.md:1 (`playground for working on JavaScript and complete HTML files`) and overview.md:3 (editor, preview and console). (4) Metadata: `difficulty = "hard"` is an allowed value; difficulty_explanation (task.toml:11) names the same editor/multi-caret undo/formatting/isolated execution/revision-safe saving axes; `category = "programming"` matches staged-task-contract; tags equal the template; provenance (task.toml:14) names Colderwater; `arena_slice = "custom-code-editor-formatting-preview-history"` restates the same axes. (5) Cross-file product name is consistent: app_context.md:3 `Name: Colderwater playground`, all five judge prompts line 1 `the live Colderwater playground`, solution package.json:2 `colderwater-playground-devtools`, server.js:12 `colderwater-playground`. No CHANGE_ME/change-me placeholder and no other product name (grep for coldwater|hireops|CHANGE_ME in task/ returned only Colderwater hits). No count is quoted in the description, so nothing to reconcile against the 38/6/3 criteria. [task].version is absent, which the row allows. Broken-identity probe: a leftover template placeholder or a description inherited from a different task would be caught by the grep above; none exists. Non-blocking observations, not defects of this row: the staged-contract comment suggests the description may also mention judge and dimension policy, but quality-checks.md:40 only requires `names this product and its actual axes`; the description uses the generic `browser code playground` rather than the brand name; the QC run id is spelled `coldwater-strict` while the task is `colderwater`, which is outside the task bytes.
